description: Final refit ONLY. The frozen walk-forward chose the architecture and the stopping point on 2024; this config spends 2024 as training data and reproduces that stopping point with a fixed step budget instead (train.py --step-budget / --lr-cut-steps). 2025 remains the held-out test season and is never scored inside training. The frozen config (split_config.json) is unchanged and stays the reference for every model-selection decision.
